lines.text: مزمند و هلاك ستوران ومرك بندكان وعزت حيوانات وضعف پيران وزحمت كاروانيان وتفرقه
lines.en: chronically ill, and the perishing of beasts of burden, and the death of slaves, and the scarcity of animals, and the weakness of the elderly, and the trouble of caravaneers, and the scattering

lines.text: در اقليم اوّل (احكام هبوط مشترى) دلالت كند بر ضعف و تنزل وزراء وقضاة وارباب
lines.en: in the first clime. (Judgments of the fall of Jupiter) It indicates the weakness and decline of viziers, judges, and lords

lines.text: مناصب و خيانت عدول وضيعه دار الشرع ونقصان تجار وافت حيوانات ونوشتن فتاوى
lines.en: of offices, and the treachery of the just, and the loss of the possessor of the law, and the decrease of merchants, and the affliction of animals, and the writing of fatwas

lines.text: وتوقف در مهمات بزرگان و بى باكى علما وفقها (احكام هبوط مريخ) دلالت كند بر ضعف
lines.en: and the halting in the important affairs of the great, and the recklessness of scholars and jurists. (Judgments of the fall of Mars) It indicates the weakness

lines.text: حال لشكريان ووهم وهراس در مردم وعزل حكام وداروغكان وزحمت مفسدان وكرفتارى
lines.en: of the condition of soldiers, and illusion and fear among the people, and the dismissal of rulers and police chiefs, and the trouble of the corrupt, and the capture

lines.text: دزدان وتعب راهداران وسرهنكان وكساد دواب وارزانى لحوم ودسوم وقتلهاى ناحق
lines.en: of thieves, and the fatigue of road guards and commanders, and the stagnation of beasts of burden, and the cheapness of meats and fats, and unjust killings

lines.text: وفساد خون در ابدان (احكام هبوط زهره) دلالت كند بر بيمارى وكدورت زنان ومخدرات
lines.en: and the corruption of blood in bodies. (Judgments of the fall of Venus) It indicates the illness and turbidity of women and veiled ones

lines.text: ومطربان وضعف اسلام وبيمارى فسق وفجور وكساد بازار اقمشه وعطريات وافت اشجار
lines.en: and musicians, and the weakness of Islam, and the illness of sin and debauchery, and the stagnation of the market of fabrics and perfumes, and the affliction of trees

lines.text: واثمار وتنكى وقبض خاطر مردم (احكام هبوط عطارد) دلالت كند بر ضيعه ونكبت وزرا
lines.en: and fruits, and the narrowness and contraction of the minds of the people. (Judgments of the fall of Mercury) It indicates the loss and misfortune of viziers

lines.text: وديوانيان واهل قلم وبهتان و اراجيف ومكر ودروغ مردم وشعر الهجا وسعايت ورسواى
lines.en: and bureaucrats and people of the pen, and calumny and rumors, and the deceit and lies of the people, and satirical poetry, and slander, and the disgrace

lines.text: اهل خيانت ونامقيدى در مال وارباب زهد وورع وتباھی حال مفسدان وغمازان و
lines.en: of the people of treachery, and the lack of restriction in wealth, and the lords of asceticism and piety, and the ruin of the condition of the corrupt and talebearers, and

lines.text: بيماريهاى كوناكون خاصه در اطفال (در احكام وبال كواكب) خانه در جودة اثر ووبال
lines.en: various illnesses, especially in children. (On the judgments of the detriment of the planets) The house in the goodness of effect and detriment

lines.text: در رداءة متقابلاند چنانكه از تباين اوضاع ايشان با يكديگر ظاهر است ومنجمان هند
lines.en: in badness are opposite, as is apparent from the contrast of their positions with each other, and the astrologers of India

lines.text: در هبوط وبال را اعتبار نكرده اند (احكام وبال زحل) دلالت كند بر عسرت وغمناكى
lines.en: have not considered detriment in the fall. (Judgments of the detriment of Saturn) It indicates hardship and sorrow

lines.text: ودرد مندى خلايق وخرابى خاندانهاى قديم ومزارعان وصحرانشينان وسركردانى احشام
lines.en: and the pain of the creatures, and the ruin of ancient families and farmers and nomads, and the wandering of livestock

lines.text: وقلعه داران وارزانى حيوانات وكدورت پيران وكوشه نشينان (احكام وبال مشترى)
lines.en: and fortress holders, and the cheapness of animals, and the turbidity of the elderly and recluses. (Judgments of the detriment of Jupiter)

lines.text: دلالت كند بر ضعف حال وزراء وسادات وقضاة ومعارف وتجار وبيمارى بزرگان و
lines.en: It indicates the weakness of the condition of viziers, and sayyids, and judges, and acquaintances, and merchants, and the illness of the great, and

lines.text: بى رونقى دار الاحتساب وناراستى در محكمها وقلعها واهل فتاوى وارزانى حبوبات وتزلزل
lines.en: the lack of prosperity of the house of reckoning, and dishonesty in courts and fortresses, and the people of fatwas, and the cheapness of grains, and the shaking

lines.text: كار علما وفقها (احكام وبال مريخ) دلالت كند بر بيمارى وتنزل حكام وامرا ولشكريان
lines.en: of the work of scholars and jurists. (Judgments of the detriment of Mars) It indicates the illness and decline of rulers, and emirs, and soldiers

lines.text: واهل سلاح وكرفتارى دزدان وشريران وكساد بازار اسلحه (احكام وبال شمس) دلالت
lines.en: and people of weapons, and the capture of thieves and the wicked, and the stagnation of the weapons market. (Judgments of the detriment of the Sun) It indicates

lines.text: كند بر افت ملوك وتنزل بزرگان وسرداران وكساد بازارها وظلم وجور در حكام وتغيير
lines.en: the affliction of kings, and the decline of the great and commanders, and the stagnation of markets, and oppression and tyranny in rulers, and the change

lines.text: هوا وافت زر ومعدنيات وتلف شدن اسبان وزدن دراهم مغشوشه وتفرقه صرافيان
lines.en: of weather, and the affliction of gold and minerals, and the perishing of horses, and the striking of adulterated dirhams, and the scattering of money changers

lines.text: وصرافان (احكام وبال زهره) دلالت كند بر بيمارى وضعف خواتين ومطربان وخواجه
lines.en: and money changers. (Judgments of the detriment of Venus) It indicates the illness and weakness of ladies, and musicians, and eunuchs

Judgments of the detriment of the planets

summary.headline: Planetary Falls and Detriments
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the falls and detriments of Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Saturn, and the Sun, describing their effects on rulers, scholars, soldiers, markets, animals, weather, health, and society. The text also contrasts the benefic and malefic houses and notes that Indian astrologers do not treat detriment in the fall.
